subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a kind of question related to Indian Parliamentary Proceedings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yearly Question**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Parliamentary Proceedings**

 
 
• The first hour of every parliamentary sitting is for **''The Question hour''.**
 
• The members ask questions and the ministers usually give answers during this time.
 
 
 
• **The questions are of three kinds**:
 
 
• **Starred question**: It requires an oral answer and hence any supplementary questions can follow.
 
• **Unstarred question**: It requires a written answer, for this reason, supplementary questions cannot follow.
 
• **Short notice question**: It is a type of question that is asked by giving a notice of fewer than ten days. It is answered orally, not require any written answer.
